text: Announcing the rebrand of the Saudi Tour as the AlUla Tour, Arab News reported: 'It will be organized by the Ministry of Sport and the Royal Commission for AlUla', staged 'in cooperation with the Saudi Cycling Federation and the International Cycling Union'.
short: AlUla Tour organised by Saudi Ministry of Sport and the Royal Commission for AlUla

source.name: Arab News - Saudi Arabia to host AlUla Tour cycling race (announcement of the 2024 rebrand)
